source.title: UV Unwrapping in Blender (Full Beginner Tutorial) #b3d
source.creator: CG Boost

analysis.study_scope: UV unwrapping fundamentals, coordinate spaces, and basic primitive unwrapping (cube and cylinder) in Blender within 0-1200s.

episodes.problem: Procedural texture coordinates swim and distort when mesh deforms via armature.
episodes.observed_fact: Rotating bone in Pose Mode warps checker pattern across Suzanne when using Generated/Object coordinates.
episodes.instructor_claim: UV coordinates lock texture coordinates to mesh surfaces during dynamic deformation.
episodes.interpretation: Generated coordinates recalculate based on object bounding box, causing texture motion during deformation.
episodes.hypothesis: Switching Texture Coordinate output to UV locks texture during mesh deformation.
episodes.reference_evidence: Texture Coordinate node switched from Generated/Object to UV output in Shader Editor.
episodes.modeling_decision: Use UV coordinate mapping for dynamic or deforming meshes.
episodes.visible_action: Connected UV output pin to Mapping node input, then rotated armature bone in Pose mode.
episodes.spoken_reason: UVs keep textures sticky and consistent across deforming models.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Texture pattern remains anchored to surface polygons during rotation and scaling.
episodes.failure: Texture swimming occurs during mesh deformation with Generated/Object coordinates.
episodes.correction: Switched Texture Coordinate node output to UV.
episodes.alternatives: Surface-deform modifier or rigid parent attachment.
episodes.transferable_principle: Use UV coordinates for deforming geometry to prevent texture swimming.

episodes.problem: Spherical gradient texture centers at lower-left corner instead of mesh center.
episodes.observed_fact: UV space origin (0,0) sits at lower-left tile corner, misaligning radial gradient center.
episodes.instructor_claim: Translating UV location by -0.5 on U and V shifts origin to plane midpoint.
episodes.interpretation: Normalized UV space spans [0,1], placing midpoint at (0.5, 0.5); offset of -0.5 aligns node center.
episodes.hypothesis: Setting Mapping Location X and Y to -0.5 aligns spherical gradient center with plane midpoint.
episodes.reference_evidence: Mapping node Location values set to X: -0.5, Y: -0.5 in Shader Editor.
episodes.modeling_decision: Offset UV coordinates in Mapping node to center origin-dependent procedural textures.
episodes.visible_action: Entered -0.5 in Mapping node Location X and Y fields.
episodes.spoken_reason: Shift origin point from corner tile to center of UV space.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Spherical gradient centers symmetrically across plane surface.
episodes.failure: Spherical gradient evaluated from lower-left vertex corner.
episodes.correction: Applied -0.5 vector offset in Mapping node Location fields.
episodes.alternatives: Translate UV island position directly within UV Editor.
episodes.transferable_principle: Understand UV origin (0,0) position to correctly transform procedural texture vectors.

episodes.problem: Initial unwrap without seams causes overlapped and heavily distorted UV polygons.
episodes.observed_fact: Marking 3 contiguous edges in a U-shape unfolds one face, leaving uncut faces distorted.
episodes.instructor_claim: Seams act like cut lines that allow 3D surfaces to unfold flat into 2D space without stretching.
episodes.interpretation: Closed 3D geometry requires seam cuts to break topological loops and allow planar flattening.
episodes.hypothesis: Marking remaining vertical and top edges will unfold all cube faces flat.
episodes.reference_evidence: Selected cube edges, executed Mark Seam, then performed U > Unwrap.
episodes.modeling_decision: Mark seam edges that split geometry into clean unfoldable T-pattern.
episodes.visible_action: Selected 7 edges total, marked seams, selected all faces, and applied Angle-Based Unwrap.
episodes.spoken_reason: Cut box edges open like flat-pack cardboard to flatten without distortion.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Cube unfolds into flat, undistorted square UV islands.
episodes.failure: Insufficient seams caused compressed/warped UV faces in viewport.
episodes.correction: Marked additional vertical and cap edge seams.
episodes.alternatives: Smart UV Project or Cube Projection.
episodes.transferable_principle: Mark seams along natural structural edges to flatten 3D mesh into 2D islands.

episodes.problem: Re-running manual Unwrap after every seam edit slows iteration.
episodes.observed_fact: Enabling Live Unwrap instantly updates UV layout whenever edge seams are marked or cleared.
episodes.instructor_claim: Live Unwrap provides instant visual feedback while testing seam placement.
episodes.interpretation: Automating UV re-evaluation on seam data changes streamlines interactive editing.
episodes.hypothesis: Live Unwrap removes repetitive hotkey execution during seam placement.
episodes.reference_evidence: Checked Live Unwrap option in 3D Viewport Options panel.
episodes.modeling_decision: Enable Live Unwrap during interactive seam placement on simple models.
episodes.visible_action: Opened Viewport Options, checked Live Unwrap, then cleared and marked seams.
episodes.spoken_reason: See real-time updates in UV Editor and 3D view when altering seams.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: UV islands update layout instantly upon marking or clearing seams.
episodes.failure: Repeated manual menu/shortcut invocation required after each seam tweak.
episodes.correction: Enabled Live Unwrap option in options tab.
episodes.alternatives: Use auto-unwrap addons or batch hotkeys.
episodes.transferable_principle: Use Live Unwrap for real-time visual feedback when designing seam strategy.

episodes.problem: Cylinder mesh unwraps into pinched radial fan pattern without vertical seam cuts.
episodes.observed_fact: Isolating cap loops detaches caps, but cylindrical wall stays pinched until sliced lengthwise.
episodes.instructor_claim: Cylindrical forms require seam loops at end caps plus one vertical seam down the side.
episodes.interpretation: A continuous cylindrical wall cannot flatten into a 2D rectangle without an axial slit.
episodes.hypothesis: Adding one vertical seam allows cylindrical side wall to unroll flat.
episodes.reference_evidence: Alt-clicked top/bottom cap loops, marked seams, then selected one vertical edge along cylinder length.
episodes.modeling_decision: Separate cylinder end caps and mark a vertical seam along cylinder body.
episodes.visible_action: Marked seam loops on caps and one vertical edge seam, then observed rectangular unwrap.
episodes.spoken_reason: Separate end caps and slice body lengthwise to lay cylinder wall flat.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Two circular cap islands and one rectangular body island in UV Editor.
episodes.failure: Uncut cylindrical body collapsed into distorted radial fan structure.
episodes.correction: Marked single vertical edge seam along body length.
episodes.transferable_principle: Unwrap cylinders by isolating end caps and cutting a seam along the longitudinal axis.
